title: Ladies' Choice/Quotes
summary:
"No Titans in front of the Amazons. We don't know how they'll react. Besides, we're trying to make friends." (Dante Vale)

"So we're going to make friends by hitting them with our fists?" (Lok Lambert)

"Well, it's worth a try, right?" (Dante Vale) 

"Mr Rassimov, this is not your day." Dante Vale to Rassimov
